title: Nurses union protests HCA Healthcare's use of Palantir AI system
key_facts: Members of the National Nurses Union rallied in downtown Asheville, North Carolina, on Thursday, 27 Aug 2026.
They called on HCA Healthcare to stop using an AI system they say affects staffing, privacy and patient care.
Protesters said the Palantir system has been used by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to identify people for deportation, and that HCA uses it to schedule nurses.
Hannah Drummond, a chief nurse representative for the National Nurses Union, said the AI nurse-scheduling program has led to poor staffing.
The Asheville protest was one of eight held across the country by the National Nurses Union.
The article does not include a response from HCA Healthcare.
